visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a white textured sweater and black trousers, and an older woman in a pink oversized hoodie with a 'R' logo, are jumping energetically with their arms raised in an indoor living room. An older man in a black and red vest is seated on a wooden sofa in the background, looking at his smartphone. (2) The pair performs rhythmic bending exercises, reaching toward their feet. The young man's sweater lifts slightly, revealing his midriff as he moves. The woman wears glasses and has her hair tied up. (3) They transition into side-stepping and swaying motions on a green yoga mat spread across the floor. The woman leads the movements with specific hand gestures while the young man follows with exaggerated, comically stiff expressions. (4) The duo stretches their arms high above their heads, interlocking their fingers. The young man exhibits a face of mock strain and physical exertion. (5) High-energy dancing and jumping ensue, where the young man flails his arms wildly and comically. The older woman continues with a more structured but equally enthusiastic pace. (6) They conclude with broad smiles and final high-energy poses directly facing the camera, with the young man gesturing playfully.
